Definition: a knot (as tied up), i.e. (figuratively) a riddle; also a vertebra (as if a knot)
BiblicalUsage: Belshazzar's thoughts trouble him so that the joints of his loins are loosed and his knees smite together — the word is the knot coming undone. Then Daniel is called, the man in whom is the dissolving of hard sentences, the untying of riddles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the knots that trouble kings are loosed by the same God who loosed Belshazzar's, and Daniel's wisdom came from him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
